_metadata.description: Rehearsal is this ramp's target-native validation: a clean-room install and command exercise that produces protocol-profile evidence. It is what converts a build claim into a runtime claim.

requirements.title: When a rehearsal starts, the ramp shall install the package in a workspace-sandbox instance that has no access to the local Vrooli runtime.
requirements.description: A rehearsal that can reach the developer's running scenarios proves nothing about an external machine. Isolation is what makes the install claim transferable, and workspace-sandbox already owns the accountability substrate for it.

validation.notes: Not implemented. Planned automated layers — api: api/internal/rehearsal/sandbox_test.go; api: api/handlers/rehearsal/module_test.go. Approach and fixtures: docs/internal/TESTING.md.

requirements.title: The ramp shall execute each command the skill documents inside the rehearsal workspace and record its exit status and redacted output.
requirements.description: The drift gate proves a command exists in the manifest; the rehearsal proves it runs after a clean install. Both are needed, because a command can be declared and still fail on a machine without the runtime it silently assumed.

requirements.title: If a rehearsal install acquires a resource the declaration did not disclose, then the ramp shall fail the package and name the undisclosed acquisition.
requirements.description: A package advertised as a standalone capability that quietly pulls Postgres, Redis, or a model runtime is a trust violation and the specific anti-pattern the channel doctrine names. The rehearsal is the only place it is observable.

requirements.title: The ramp shall run the install script twice within one rehearsal and fail the package when the second run is not a no-op.
requirements.description: Agents re-run install steps routinely, often after a partial failure. A non-idempotent install corrupts the user's machine on the second attempt, and the failure surfaces far from its cause.

requirements.title: When a rehearsal finishes, the ramp shall emit a protocol-profile journey manifest carrying gate dispositions and reference-only artifacts.
requirements.description: The shared delivery spine already defines a protocol evidence profile that does not require visual artifacts, so this ramp reports through it rather than inventing a parallel evidence shape. Verdicts carry references; recordings and logs stay with the producer.

requirements.title: Where a skill requires a paid entitlement, the rehearsal should prove the sign-in path resolves entitlement at run time and that no credential is present in the artifact.
requirements.description: A paid capability must gate on a token the user obtains after install, never on a secret shipped inside the package. Proving that in the rehearsal is what allows a paid skill to be published on the same channel as a free one without a separate trust story.
